## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run pytest -q` pass
- [ ] Issues, commits, tests and fixtures contain only fictional data (no real conversations, names, account IDs or machine paths)
- [ ] If a README changed, `README.md`, `README.zh-TW.md` and `README.zh-CN.md` were updated together
- [ ] Labeled for the release notes (`bug`, `enhancement`, `documentation`, `breaking-change`, or `skip-changelog`)
